search_text: published ZDI-20-809 ZDI-CAN-10527 C-MORE HMI EA9 EA-HTTP Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2020-07-07 CVE-2020-10922 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2020-10922 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['C-MORE'] ['HMI EA9'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of C-More HMI EA9 touch screen panels. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the EA-HTTP.exe process. The issue results from the lack of proper input validation prior to further processing user requests. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. Fixed in version 6.60 ['2020-06-25 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2020-07-07 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2020-07-08 - Advisory Updated'] evanslify https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-20-809/
title: C-MORE HMI EA9 EA-HTTP Improper Input Validation Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of C-More HMI EA9 touch screen panels. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the EA-HTTP.exe process. The issue results from the lack of proper input validation prior to further processing user requests. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
